source.title: Regeneration

actual_source_status: Own source begins <noinclude>{{outdated}}</noinclude>; do not present as confirmed current complete rates.

quotes.quote: All vocations regenerate mana and hitpoints at different rates.
If a player has purchased a [[promotion]], then they will regenerate [[Mana]] and/or [[Hitpoint]]s faster.
This bonus also affects all regenerative items, meaning their efficiency will be twice the numbers displayed on the related pages.

findings: General health/mana regeneration varies by vocation and promotion; food type does not change base rate.
Resting-area DailyReward streak boosts double efficiency of regenerative items; explicit context condition, not a globally doubled perItem intrinsic rate.
Raw source graphs refer to Calculator/Mana Per Second and Calculator/Hit Points Per Second *3600 perhour; actual calculator raw values are not present in this article and were not fetched/evaluated.
SpecialItems section separates instant restorative potions/runes/spells from regenerative equipment, so do not inherit potion/use amounts into intrinsic HealthGain/ManaGain modifier facts.
Own source uses DPL category/template tables referencing intrinsic attrib but does not contain exact own numericItemID/rate/interval rows for the14candidate Items.

This article alone cannot turn unquantified ownWiki fasterregeneration into exact SignedPoints/Milliseconds values; XML equip-target rates remain scoped OTS hypotheses without exact ownItem source/phase proof.
held_native_claims: No one universal gain amount/interval for all14.
No transfer of equipped-target XML values to unequipped/base ownID.
No healthticks/manaTicks time-unit conversion or runtimeclock/activation formula inferred from this article.
No title/DPL category to numerical item identity or family/tier inference.
